spec.description: The alerts in effect for one forecast zone or county. The same as `alerts.get_active_alerts` narrowed by `zone`, with the zone in the path. Takes no other filter, so drills and test messages come back too; `alerts.get_active_alerts` with `status: ["actual"]` leaves them out.

zone_id.description: Forecast zone (`WAZ315`) or county (`AZC009`) code: two letters of state or marine area, `Z` or `C`, three digits.

response.description: The alerts in effect for the zone, as a GeoJSON feature collection. Empty when there are none.

notes: `zone_id` is a plain string for the reason `alerts.get_active_alerts` gives for `zone`: the service constrains it with a regex, not an enumeration.
